title: Durably commit every persistent TrustStore security mutation
description: python/src/lichen/crypto/trust.py accepts a persistence backend but verify_or_pin, add_trust_anchor, revoke, and remove mutate memory and return success without saving; only rotate_key performs a transactional persistence commit. A crash after a first TOFU pin, anchor upgrade, or revocation therefore reopens first-contact trust or resurrects a revoked key, while the API has already reported success. When persistence is configured, make each security transition commit before exposure with full in-memory rollback on any BaseException; retain clearly named unsafe test-only in-memory helpers if needed. Add crash/failing-backend/CAS tests for every mutator.
